serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Accenture Federal Cloud ERP is a secure cloud offering delivering virtualized back-office ERP solutions, covering Financial Management, Property/Asset Management, HR and Payroll, to US federal customers. Accenture leverages Oracle applications (E-Business Suite, PeopleSoft, OBIEE, Hyperion) and other COTS applications (Sunflower), cloud technology and assets from 20+ years of experience to help customers to meet their unique mission requirements.
